services_heading: Complete Tree Surgery Services Across Birmingham
services_subhead: From routine pruning to emergency felling and stump removal—we handle every tree job safely and efficiently.

services.title: Emergency Tree Felling
services.desc: Dangerous, diseased, or storm-damaged trees removed fast. We work around the clock in Birmingham and beyond. Safe rope access and crane hire available for difficult removals.

services.title: Tree Pruning & Crowning
services.desc: Crown reduction, thinning, and shaping to improve light and reduce wind resistance. Keeps your trees healthy and your garden safe year-round.

services.title: Stump Grinding & Removal
services.desc: We grind stumps below ground level or remove them entirely—leaving your garden clear and ready to use. Fast, clean, and no mess left behind.

services.title: Hedge Cutting & Maintenance
services.desc: Regular trimming keeps hedges neat and healthy. We work to your preferred height and thickness, with site cleanup included.

services.title: Tree Surgery After Storm Damage
services.desc: Fallen branches, uprooted trees, and split trunks—we clear debris and make unsafe areas safe again. Often available within hours of your call.

services.title: Tree Reports & Surveys
services.desc: Expert assessment of tree health, stability, and risk. Ideal before buying a property or when you're unsure about a large tree's safety.

about_pullquote: We climb where others won't, and we do it right—safely, fairly, and on time.
about_para_1: Able Tree Surgery has been keeping Birmingham's gardens and properties safe for nearly two decades. Founded on a simple principle—treat every tree job as if it's in your own back garden—we've built a reputation for honest pricing, skilled climbers, and work that's done properly. We're fully insured and hold all the qualifications needed for high-access work, rope work, and hazard tree removal.
about_para_2: Homeowners and property managers across Birmingham know they can ring us in an emergency and we'll be there. We don't cut corners or overcharge. Many of our customers call us year after year for routine pruning; others know we're their first call when a tree becomes dangerous. That's because we listen, we explain the job clearly, and we leave your garden cleaner than we found it.
reviews_heading: What Birmingham Homeowners Say About Able Tree Surgery

reviews.text: Had a massive oak tree that was leaning toward the house after the storm. Called Able at 8am, they arrived by 10 and had it safely felled and cleared by lunch. Professional crew, fair price, no faffing about. Brilliant.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Regular pruning of our front hedge—they come twice a year, always on time, always do a thorough job. The garden looks so much better. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Catherine L.

reviews.text: Stump grinding service was outstanding. The guys got in, did the work quickly, and the garden's now completely clear. Really pleased with the result and the price was honest. Will use again.
reviews.author: David M.
